headline: Unusual-trading activity is concentrated in TPOLY, M-PAT and PLE, with TPOLY's 20.00% intraday move following a filing on changes to shareholding structure and control of its subsidiary.
market_take: Coverage is mixed, with sharp downside moves in TRITN (-33.33%), GEL (-25.00%), TPOLY (-20.00%) and M-PAT (-8.57%) alongside gains in KC (+50.00%) and CGD (+11.11%). Many alerts reflect price gaps or intraday volatility rather than heavy turnover, while M-PAT, APCS, MK and CMC stand out on volume spikes. Filings are active across CONS, CONMAT, PROP, PF&REIT, FOOD and AGRI, so several names warrant follow-up before trading.

sector_notes.note: TPOLY fell -20.00% with a -10.00% open gap and a -11.11% intraday move, following a filing on changes to its shareholding structure and control of a subsidiary. PLE recorded a +20.00% open gap and a -16.67% intraday move, while TRITN fell -33.33%.
M-PAT fell -8.57% on a 459.1σ volume spike and a -10.71% open gap, making it the most prominent liquidity event in the coverage. QHBREIT also filed on a capital reduction.
AMATA fell -6.09% on a 3.9σ volume spike, while MK and CMC showed volume spikes of 10.8σ and 24.0σ respectively. ASW filed on the disposal of shares in an indirect subsidiary.

GEL fell -25.00% on an intraday move, while DCON gained +6.67% on a +6.67% open gap. SCC filed an update on a potential strategic joint venture for its olefins and polyolefins business alongside Q3/2026 results.
SST and ZEN showed volume spikes of 4.4σ and 4.6σ versus the 20-day average, and AQUA opened -9.09%. SST also filed on a board resolution regarding disposal of assets and a lease.
